_comment: Copy to config/local.json (git-ignored) and edit for this machine. Every key is optional. routes overrides the tier assignments in router.json; each target must be in router.json's models roster. Leave out models this machine does not have.
_escalation: pi workers on these models hand off after more than after_consecutive_errors failed tool calls in a row.
_mlx: The local model bin/tp-mlx serves; pi's mlx provider in agent/models.json must list the same model id.
_rules: Send a task type a model is known to get wrong elsewhere: when the router picks a model in from and the task text matches pattern, use to.

rules._why: Qwen3.5-4B reports counts without computing them (wrong on 4 of 24 counting chores; Slotstream 10/10). See tests/calibration/experiments.md.

_prompts: Extra system-prompt text for a model's workers, for a mistake it is known to make. Qwen3.5-4B's counting: 76% correct without, 90% with (tests/calibration/experiments.md).

prompts.mlx/mlx-community/Qwen3.5-4B-MLX-4bit: Only answer a count with a number printed by a counting command you have run (grep -c, wc -l, or jq length for JSON); if you have not run one yet, run it before answering.

_followup: A fast local chat model judges whether a new message belongs to a running delegated task; between the two ask_between probabilities the user is asked. Without this key Laya judges, and asks more often (tests/calibration/experiments.md).
_packet_files: Workers on these models get up to 3 files, picked by the selector (a Claude model, via claude -p), in their context packet. Qwen3.5-4B: 44/60 chores without, 53/60 with; Slotstream gained nothing (tests/calibration/experiments.md).
